name: Efficient
rationale: Haemolysis screen and film; film review shows stippling; targeted remedy question; blood lead. The case must show: Stippling on review; H10 only on a specific question; blood lead 77.8 µg/dL

name: Warm AIHA
rationale: IgG 1+ DAT, agglutination on the film, haemolysis markers. The case must show: A weak IgG-only DAT in a group A patient on IVIG is likely passive; no spherocytes; steroids are a must-not-do

name: IVIG-associated haemolysis
rationale: Group A patient on IVIG with a positive DAT. The case must show: A plausible contributor, not the diagnosis; the eluate result is a judgement call

name: Sideroblastic anaemia or MDS
rationale: Ring sideroblasts and dyserythropoiesis in the marrow. The case must show: No clonal markers; copper normal; little alcohol; no culprit drugs

name: Plasma cell disorder
rationale: Atypical plasma cells, raised free light chains, anaemia. The case must show: No paraprotein; normal ratio; polyclonal on flow; no bone lesions

name: Acute porphyria
rationale: Abdominal pain with anaemia. The case must show: Porphobilinogen not in the acute range; ALA and coproporphyrin raised

name: Gastrointestinal cause
rationale: Abdominal pain. The case must show: Examination, lipase, imaging and endoscopy normal or non-specific

name: Haemoglobinopathy or red cell enzyme disorder
rationale: Basophilic stippling with haemolysis; inherited pyrimidine 5′-nucleotidase deficiency is the classic differential. The case must show: HPLC normal; MCV normal; iron replete. Pyrimidine 5′-nucleotidase activity is low because lead inhibits the enzyme, which can mislead a player towards the inherited disorder

name: Myositis and neuromuscular
rationale: Known IBM; raised CK and transaminases. The case must show: IBM pattern; no neuropathy; CK, aldolase and troponin T fit myositis

name: Drug-related anaemia
rationale: Mycophenolate recently started. The case must show: Reticulocytosis argues against marrow suppression; no drugs that cause sideroblastic anaemia

name: Infection while immunosuppressed
rationale: Anaemia on immunosuppression. The case must show: No active parvovirus or CMV; afebrile; CRP normal

name: Other heavy metals
rationale: The supplement is disclosed. The case must show: Mercury and arsenic values set by Atul (the product contained both)
